cases.title: A token in run text is replaced by the value
cases.notes: The whole feature in one row.

cases.title: Several tokens and text in one string
The document title is a text field
An absent variable with a declared default takes it
A dotted path walks an object; a property's own default applies
cases.notes: Defaults apply at every level (SPEC 4), and an integer in a text field is its digits.

cases.title: A number in a text field is JavaScript's Number#toString
cases.notes: The cross-language row. PHP's (string) of a float uses `precision` (14 digits) and its json_encode uses `serialize_precision` and writes 1.0e+21; Python's str writes 3.0 and 1e+21; only one of the three is the spec. -0 is "0", as in JavaScript.

cases.title: A boolean in a text field is true or false
cases.notes: Not 1 and the empty string, which is PHP's native cast.

cases.title: An array in a text field is TEMPLATE_NOT_SCALAR
cases.notes: Never `Array`, `[object Object]` or a JSON dump. The way to write a list is `| join`.

cases.title: An absent optional variable in a token is TEMPLATE_MISSING
cases.notes: THE RULE the plan calls 'missing data is loud'. Not an empty string: an empty string is what laravel-courses' Blade templates silently produced. The path names the template field, never the data.

cases.title: Digits index into an array
An index past the end is absent: TEMPLATE_MISSING
cases.notes: Absent, not an error of a different kind and not an empty string.

cases.title: `{{ "{{" }}` renders a literal `{{`
cases.notes: How an author writes about templates inside a template.

cases.title: Numbers, booleans and token-free strings in the document pass through
cases.notes: Key order is the template's. `{page}` in a run is fine-print's business, not ours.

cases.title: Missing required data stops render with the DATA code and a data path
cases.notes: SPEC 11: inspect, then validateData, then render; the first failure is thrown.

cases.title: An undeclared token stops render before data is looked at
cases.notes: The template is wrong whatever the data says, and that is the more useful thing to hear first.

cases.title: Data the template does not declare is ignored
cases.notes: Not an error, and not reachable: inspect refuses any token naming an undeclared variable, so extra data can never reach a document (SPEC 4).

cases.title: Valid data has no errors
Every absent required variable is listed, in declaration order
cases.notes: All errors, not the first: a form should show every field at once.

cases.title: null is DATA_TYPE for any type
cases.notes: null is not absent. A host sending null for 'no subtitle' should omit the key; accepting null would give every variable two spellings of nothing.

cases.title: maxLength counts code points, not bytes or UTF-16 units
cases.notes: JSON Schema's unit. Łód is 3 code points and 5 bytes; two emoji are 2 code points and 4 UTF-16 units. A byte count fails a, a UTF-16 count fails c.

cases.title: integer accepts 3.0, rejects 3.5; strings are never numbers; "true" is not a boolean
cases.notes: No coercion of any kind.

cases.title: A value outside enum is DATA_ENUM
Calendar dates and times are checked for real
cases.notes: 2024 is a leap year and 2026 is not. A regex alone passes b.

cases.title: An image is a PNG or JPEG data URL whose bytes match its type
cases.notes: d is labelled PNG and carries JPEG bytes: the magic-byte check, not the label, decides. f is a local path, which is exactly what dark-slide's ImageResolver would read off the host's disk.

cases.title: Errors inside objects and arrays carry their full pointer
cases.notes: Declaration order: tags is declared before program.

cases.title: Data that is not an object is DATA_TYPE at the root
A required variable with a default may be absent
preview renders each variable's example

runs.text: Ada Lovelace / Analytical Engines / Particle Academy

cases.notes: issuer has no example and falls back to its default.

cases.title: A required variable with neither example nor default fails preview
cases.notes: A preview that invented a value would show the admin a document the real data cannot produce.
